## Description

The checklist: identity confirmed, allergies reconciled, medicines reconciled, recording consent recorded, history reviewed, every AI suggestion accepted or dismissed, diagnoses reviewed and plan reviewed. The Sign button stays locked and says how many items remain. The server refuses a signature while an AI draft or suggestion is still undecided or consent is unrecorded, so the lock is not only the screen. After signing, changes go in as an addendum, as today.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Signing with an undecided AI suggestion is refused by the server (test, mutation checked).
- [ ] **AC2.** The remaining count and each item are announced to screen readers.
- [ ] **AC3.** The checklist state is derived from the note, never stored separately.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
